thread:
Iris (PM): Heads up — thinking about a small "Lighthouse" partner cohort for Private/Dedicated preview. Goal: validate onboarding flow, configs (batching/quant), and rollout checklist. Need to settle recruitment funnel, capacity, clear success criteria, and legal gating. Thoughts?

Diego (Product Ops): +1. How big are we thinking? 3–10 partners?

Iris (PM): 4–6 initially. We want depth over breadth — integrations that exercise runtime routing, dedicated pool sizing, and real traffic patterns.

Maya (Research): Agree on smaller. Selection criteria idea: 1) integration depth (calls > 10k tokens/day), 2) SLA sensitivity, 3) willing to share prompt sets & evals, 4) product/exec sponsor. Also timeframe: 6–8 weeks active.

Sam (Eng): From infra side, we can reserve a 2-GPU pool for 4 partners low-risk, but we need model pinning and fallback policy defined. If partners test different quantization profiles we should limit variants to 2 per partner early.

Lina (Solutions): I can run onboarding + 1:1 setup sessions. Suggest onboarding checklist snippet we should include in invite: 

```
- Pre-call: share app flow + sample prompts
- Screening call: integration plan + data access needs
- Day 0: config baseline (model, quant, batch)
- Week 1: traffic ramp + latency baseline
- Weekly: feedback + prompt evals
```

Diego (Product Ops): Love the checklist. For recruitment funnel: Outreach -> 20 interest form -> 8 screening calls -> 4 accepted. We should prepare an intake form with tags: use-case, expected QPS, data sensitivity, contact level.

Eve (Legal): We'll need a short DPPA-lite agreement for telemetry + model telemetry opt-in. NDA alone isn't enough if they send PII. Also flag customers who require KMS/HSM for private keys. I can prep a slim addendum.

Maya (Research): Success metrics proposal (combine product & infra):
- Engagement: >= 3 weekly active sessions per partner
- Quality: no regression vs baseline on 3 curated eval prompts (pass/fail)
- Reliability: 99% of inference calls within agreed SLO (p50/p95 targets)
- Value: partner-specific milestone (e.g., embed feature live or internal beta)

Iris (PM): Good. Also include a business metric (lead conversion or retention signal) where possible. We should have a go/no-go at week 3 for continuing ramp.

Sam (Eng): Operational constraints: we need a rollback plan per partner and a fallback model (smaller baseline) that can be triggered automatically. I'll draft the policy. Also request: one debug endpoint per partner with limited retention.

Lina (Solutions): For prompts and evals, can we provide a private workspace template (notebooks + eval harness) so partners can run locally before sending real traffic? That reduces risk.

Diego (Product Ops): I can draft the invite email. Draft subject ideas: "Join Redwood Lighthouse: private preview for Dedicated inference". Example invite blurb in thread: 

"We’re inviting a small group of partners to test Dedicated inference with reserved capacity, tailored onboarding, and direct engineering support. Expect a 6–8 week program with weekly check-ins and success milestones. Apply here: [intake form link]"

Eve (Legal): +1 to clear data handling bullets in the invite. Also call out that telemetry will be aggregated unless explicit.

Maya (Research): Screening call script quick bullets: 
- Current infra & traffic patterns
- Key success metric for partner
- Data sensitivity & compliance needs
- Commitment: 4 hours/week of partnership time

Iris (PM): Action items & owners: 
- Diego: create intake form + first invite draft by Tue EOD (owner)
- Lina: onboarding checklist + workspace template by next Wed
- Sam: rollback + fallback policy + debug endpoint spec by next Thu
- Eve: NDA addendum + telemetry addendum draft by next Fri
- Maya: prepare 3 eval prompts template + baseline dataset by next Wed
- Iris: finalize partner acceptance rubric and run shortlist meeting on Fri

Diego (Product Ops): I'll put a calendar block for outreach cadence and a Notion page for intake scoring.

Lina (Solutions): I'll take 1st onboarding session for the first accepted partner. Happy to pair with Maya on evals.

Sam (Eng): FYI: we'll need an ops runbook for quick scale-up if partner traffic spikes during testing. I'll add that to the spec.

Eve (Legal): I'll circulate the addendum drafts and mark any items that require sales sign-off.

Iris (PM): Great work team. Target: outreach starts two weeks from today. Reactions welcome here (:thumbsup:, :eyes:).
